findings.description: The deployment user is granted ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* against every resource. This violates least privilege and allows broad access to S3 data and extensive modification of infrastructure; it can also enable privilege escalation through service capabilities such as Lambda execution roles.

The IAM access-key secret material is exposed through an output without sensitive = true. This can print the credential in Terraform CLI output and expose it to downstream consumers; it is also retained in Terraform state as part of the access-key resource.
